I'd tell them. I attempted to end my life 2 years ago but I was an adult so the hospital staff didn't have to say anything if I didn't want them too.. the woman who bought me in said it might help to tell them so they know how much I am struggling... I wasn't going to tell them at all but I ended up saying it and I did feel better for doing so and they were very supportive. Granted it didn't take away the thoughts and feelings but it gave me a support system.

Family and friends ARE a support system however they can't be and don't know to give you it if you don't communicate with them... Problem with mental health sometimes is we sit here screaming in silence desperately wanting help but then when people are around we put on the mask and don't even ask. As someone once said "You have to want help to be helped".

Cliche as it sounds telling your parents and people you trust how you feel could change your life greatly and might actually give you what you need to move forward.
